newsitem.title: GERMANY: RTL, BMW unit found software venture.
newsitem.headline: RTL, BMW unit found software venture.

text.p: Europe's largest TV channel, Germany's RTL, has founded a 50/50 joint venture with Softlab, a unit of car maker BMW AG, to offer a universal software application for use in the television industry.
The venture, to be called S4M (Solutions for Media), will offer work solutions for programme producers, editors and planners, as well as advertising sellers and administrators.
The software package will be marketed initially to the television industry, and a version will be developed for the print media, Softlab said.
